children.label: playground — :5200 ⌄
children.annotations: Server selector occupies Sculpted’s component-selector position. Menu contains playground — :5200 and playground — :5202; retain port and optional root to distinguish servers. No credentials. Lucide ChevronDown. No server: waiting label and the existing start-server instruction in the body.

Lucide SquareMousePointer, 16px (13px for row actions). Tooltip and accessible name: Pick element. Use Sculpted’s header Inspect location and stable icon. Pressed while picking; activate again to stop. Native-only client: disabled with Web app required. Picking chooses style sites rather than replacing the mounted tweak inventory.

Lucide Pin, 16px (13px for row actions). Tooltip and accessible name: Keep on top. Native-only window state, on in these examples. Omit in web. This replaces browser docking/window actions, which do not apply to a standalone native window.

Match Sculpted PanelHeader alignment, 12px horizontal inset, 6px control spacing and 24px icon targets. Server identity replaces selected-component identity. Native window chrome supplies close; no duplicate close/dock/settings controls or empty More menu.
Lucide ChevronRight/ChevronDown disclosure; preserve expansion and group ordering during edits. This group hierarchy is required by useTweak metadata.

children.label: ⟲ Revert all
children.annotations: Lucide RotateCcw, 16px; retain Revert all label because the action includes filtered/off-screen tweaks and style drafts. Revert restores source values; no source write.

Lucide Save, 16px. Tooltip/accessibility name: Save changes to source. Save writes all pending drafts directly with no diff preview or confirmation. Show Saving… in the summary until completion. Preserve editor focus, filters, expanded sites, and scroll position. Success: Saved N files, and dirty clears from server state. Failure: retain drafts and show file-specific errors above the footer; a partial failure never claims complete success. Review the resulting diff in existing developer tools and perform follow-up saves as needed.

Necessary difference from Sculpted autosave: a fixed, low-chrome footer for explicit Save/Revert and global pending work. Match Sculpted’s neutral action styling; no large primary text button, review view, or autosave implication. Save stays at the lower right. Busy/failure status is inline, not a modal.

root.annotations: Design baseline: ~/dev/alloc/sculpted/src/ui/inspectorPanel.tsx (PanelHeader/source headings), src/ui/inspectorEditableTargets.tsx (property grid, filter and AddPropertyMenu), src/ui/inputs/rawValueInput.tsx (normal/changed/disabled fields), and src/ui/inspectorPanel.css (code type and icon targets). Reuse Sculpted’s design rather than inventing an alternate inspector language. Actual styling should match its white surface, neutral gray rules/text, restrained blue changed inputs, 13px body text, 12px monospace code labels/source paths, 6px field corners, 24px icon targets and quiet source sections. The wireframe tool fixes palette/type, so the exact colors and fonts are implementation annotations, not a new theme. Use inline native style props to express the same hierarchy; lack of CSS does not justify redesigning it. Keep only necessary adaptations: server identity/connection, native keep-on-top, mounted tweak/file/site grouping, generic number/boolean/text/color/select controls, pick-as-site-filter, site-wide revert, and an explicit Save footer. Sculpted’s autosave/Git-dirty semantics are not reused: these dirty fields mean unsaved drafts and clear on confirmed save. Do not add browser-only docking, component-layer navigation, Panda token catalogs, responsive/state lanes, source attachment or other unsupported features. Lucide icon choices follow the approved mapping. Glyph placeholders: ⚲ Pin; ⌖ SquareMousePointer; ▣ Save; ↶ Undo2; × Trash2 in property rows or X in filter clear; ⌄/› ChevronDown/ChevronRight; ⟲ RotateCcw; + Plus. The format has no icon/SVG node, so glyphs are symbolic. All icon controls require accessible names, keyboard focus and tooltips. Pin and Pick keep stable icons with visible pressed treatment. No application code is changed by this design proposal. Primary editing state: all generic input types remain visible. Dirty is shown in the changed field and trailing restore affordance, with an unsaved summary in the footer. No extra dot gutter or row shading.
